# Lap count (race_laps.cpp, rr_ko_modes.cpp): every reader of the race scenario's lap count turns a
# count past 9 into 3 (`lapCount - 1 > 8`: cmplwi r0, 8). Raceinfo::__ct, the lap count getter and
# the three race functions with the same inline choice compare with 98 instead, so 1..99 laps hold
# (a 15-lap race ran 3; Lap KO's 23 laps drew the lap counter for 3 and read past its textures).
# cmpimm: the offset field lists the compare's accepted original values: 8, or 12 where Retro
# Rewind's patch already raised it (its own races go to 13 laps).
0x805328C0  0  cmpimm  98  0xC08  # Raceinfo::__ct
0x805336C8  0  cmpimm  98  0xC08  # Raceinfo lap count getter
0x80534360  0  cmpimm  98  0xC08  # inline lap count (0x805342E8)
0x80534BCC  0  cmpimm  98  0xC08  # inline lap count (0x805349B8)
0x80534D04  0  cmpimm  98  0xC08  # inline lap count (0x80534CCC)
